desc.en: Reveal the aura of all other survivors within 24 m.
desc.zh: 显示 24 米内其他逃生者的气场。

desc.en: Start sprinting and gain 150% speed for 3 s. 40 s cooldown.
desc.zh: 起跑时获得 150% 移速，持续 3 秒。冷却 40 秒。

desc.en: Heal yourself without a medkit, at 60% of the normal speed.
desc.zh: 无需医疗包即可自我治疗，速度为正常的 60%。

desc.en: Crouch-move 45% faster.
desc.zh: 蹲伏移动速度提升 45%。

desc.en: When the last generator is repaired, instantly heal and gain 150% speed for 5 s.
desc.zh: 最后一台发电机修复时立刻治愈，并获得 150% 移速 5 秒。

desc.en: While injured, sprinting grants a 1 s burst of invulnerability. 60 s cooldown.
desc.zh: 受伤状态下奔跑可获得 1 秒免伤窗口。冷却 60 秒。

desc.en: The survivor you unhook gains Endurance for 10 s.
desc.zh: 被你救下的逃生者获得 10 秒坚毅。

desc.en: After a fast vault, gain 150% speed for 3 s. 40 s cooldown.
desc.zh: 快速翻越后获得 150% 移速 3 秒。冷却 40 秒。

desc.en: While injured, all interactions are 15% faster.
desc.zh: 受伤状态下所有交互速度提升 15%。

desc.en: Warn yourself when the killer is looking in your direction.
desc.zh: 当杀手朝你的方向注视时给出预警。

desc.en: While someone is hooked, reveal the killer and all survivors.
desc.zh: 有人被挂钩时，显示杀手与所有逃生者的气场。

desc.en: Healing yourself or others is 33% faster.
desc.zh: 治疗自己或他人的速度提升 33%。

desc.en: Dismantle bear traps twice as fast and take 50% less time to escape them.
desc.zh: 拆除捕兽夹速度翻倍，挣脱时间减少 50%。

desc.en: A failed generator skill check only explodes 25% of the time, and never reveals your location.
desc.zh: 发电机技能判定失败时仅有 25% 概率爆炸，且绝不会暴露你的位置。

desc.en: When the killer breaks a pallet or a wall, reveal their aura to you (and nearby survivors) for 6 s.
desc.zh: 当杀手破坏木板或墙体时，你与附近逃生者会看到其气场，持续 6 秒。

desc.en: Break pallets 20% faster.
desc.zh: 破坏木板速度提升 20%。

desc.en: Pallet stuns last 50% less time.
desc.zh: 被木板击晕的时间减少 50%。

desc.en: You can sense when a survivor is within 20 m.
desc.zh: 20 米内有逃生者时你会有所察觉。

desc.en: Every time a generator is finished, reveal survivors near it for 5 s.
desc.zh: 每台发电机完成时，显示附近逃生者 5 秒。

desc.en: Once all generators are powered, gain 4% speed and expose survivors.
desc.zh: 所有发电机通电后，移速 +4% 且逃生者陷入暴露状态。

desc.en: Missed attacks recover 30% faster.
desc.zh: 攻击落空后的后摇减少 30%。

desc.en: Reveal the aura of downed survivors.
desc.zh: 显示倒地逃生者的气场。

desc.en: Blood trails last noticeably longer and glow brighter.
desc.zh: 血迹留存时间更长，且更显眼。

desc.en: Survivors you injure heal 25% slower.
desc.zh: 被你击伤的逃生者治疗速度降低 25%。
